name: @flowforge/webhook-github
description: FlowForge signed GitHub HTTP webhook adapter (A29 / EP1-9) — a signature-verified (HMAC-SHA256 against the `x-hub-signature-256` header), bounded-UTF-8, GitHub JSON adapter that parses request bodies and dispatches `github`-kind deliveries into the fire-and-forget webhook runtime. Ported from dsh `webhook-github`; the host services (credentials, host-webserver, webhook runtime, util-values) are injected package-local seams with real in-memory implementations. The GitHub HMAC signature verification is self-implemented with node:crypto (no @octokit dependency), because @octokit/webhooks is unavailable in this environment.
